# authwise_realm_authentication_context_schema (Data Source)

What a realm's authentication rules can be written against: the variables a rule `condition` may read, the factor types this kit build runs, and kit's warnings about the policy the realm holds now — the same warnings a write returns. A `check` block over `warnings` surfaces a doubtful policy on every plan, not only on the apply that wrote it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `realm` (String) Full resource name of the realm (`tenants/{t}/realms/{r}`).

### Read-Only

- `factor_types` (Attributes List) Every factor type kit knows, and whether this build runs it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--factor_types))
- `variables` (Attributes List) What a rule condition may read, in kit's documented order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--variables))
- `warnings` (List of String) The realm's stored policy judged against its enabled factors. Empty when kit has nothing to say.

<a id="nestedatt--factor_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `factor_types`

Read-Only:

- `amr` (List of String)
- `classes` (List of String)
- `config_message` (String) The message the factor's `config` carries for this type; empty for none.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this build runs it; kit refuses a factor of a type it does not.
- `factor_type` (String) The slug an `authwise_factor` and a rule name.
- `phishing_resistant` (Boolean)
- `recovery` (Boolean) A look-up secret; never the method a requirement is met by.
- `restricted` (Boolean) NIST's restricted class (SMS): offered only beside an unrestricted method.
- `supports_enrollment` (Boolean) False where enrolment happens elsewhere (Duo).


<a id="nestedatt--variables"></a>
### Nested Schema for `variables`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `name` (String) The CEL path, e.g. `risk.level`.
- `type` (String) The CEL type, e.g. `string`, `list(string)`.
